pages.text: The Akaishi Purifier is still very much in service as a $(4)self-fueling single-block refiner$(0): drop Akaishi Crystals or Raw Akaishi Blocks into the fuel slot, and it burns them into energy that converts a Raw Akaishi Block in the input slot into $(bold)1 essence$(0) — or an Akaishi Crystal Block into $(bold)4 essence$(0).$(br2)$(bold)Three tips:$(0)$(li)It has its own fuel slot — $(bold)it runs without a grid$(0)$(li)Speed upgrades accelerate it, and an energy pipe can lend a hand$(li)Never feed essence as fuel — it only burns crystals and raw blocks

When output can't keep up, stop circling the Purifier: the $(4)Purifier Matrix$(0) is a $(bold)standalone bulk-refining multiblock$(0) — frame a 3×3×3 cavity with Purifier Matrix Casing, then add the controller, an energy input port and item input/output ports. Once formed, the controller refines in bulk at $(4)30x speed$(0): Raw Akaishi Block → 1 essence, Akaishi Crystal Block → 4 essence.$(br2)$(bold)One key difference:$(0) the matrix has no fuel slot — $(e)it lives on grid power$(0). Full wall checklist and build guide: "$(l:akaishi:purifier_matrix)Purifier Matrix$(/l)".

Reading order: ore brings crystals → craft them into raw blocks → squeeze essence out of them with the Purifier → feed the essence into the concentration chain. Going big? Open the Purifier Matrix entry and start building.
